plan.screen: 2 epochs on fold A with the original 4-epoch schedule horizon
plan.promotion: top six noncontrol trials by fold A best-rule pooled PQ, plus t00
plan.confirmation: fit promoted configurations for 4 epochs independently on new date-group folds E and F
plan.selection: maximize the smaller of the E and F PQ gains over t00 direct50, then mean PQ; one shared inference rule
plan.tie_break: lower trial number, then rule insertion order
plan.final: refit selected recipe and t00 for 4 epochs on all 500 training images; score the holdout after both predictions are sealed
